name: Xilong Scientific Co., Ltd.
summary: Xilong Scientific Co., Ltd. researches and develops, manufactures, and sells chemical reagents in China. The company offers general chemical reagents, PCB chemical reagents, high-purity chemical reagents, wet electronic chemicals, industrial raw materials, food additives, photovoltaic electrode materials, and Lithium battery positive electrode materials. It also exports its products. Xilong Scientific Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Xilong Chemical Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Xilong Scientific Co., Ltd. in December 2015. Xilong Scientific Co., Ltd. was founded in 1983 and is based in Guangzhou, China.
